features.title: رحلة القضية وحفظ الأصل
features.summary: Preserve origins, original evidence, linked follow-ups and answer versions; keep approval, delivery and publication separate.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Replayed synthetic intake retains one case with original identifiers and ordered attachments.
Verified follow-ups reuse the case; ambiguous links wait for review; closure preserves history.
New substantive evidence blocks approval until mufti review; metadata changes do not raise the evidence version.
Only an authorized mufti approves an immutable version; publication and delivery require separate authority.
Unsupported reply parts are reported without omission or channel changes; delivery requires provider evidence.

features.title: مساحة المفتي والأجوبة
features.summary: Provide one mufti workspace to read unchanged evidence, compose ordered replies, review updates and select precise citations.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Original questions, attachments and follow-ups remain in order; requester identities stay private.
New evidence requires explicit review acknowledgement before approval; merely opening the case is insufficient.
Autosave and concurrent editing preserve human drafts and distinguish saved from approved replies.
Research cannot write into the composer automatically; selected citations preview the exact source and position with source access enforced.
Ordered reply parts and original audio are preserved; mobile reading/recording enforces sensitive access.

features.title: عمليات التنظيم قيد الاعتماد
features.summary: Track organizer queues, assignments, metadata, previews, delivery, identity review, bulk operations and audit without granting scholarly authority.

owner_approval.scope: Exact acceptance of the unit clauses is pending; narrower later decisions do not approve the unit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 48 clauses remain pending; D-067 does not approve the unit or grant operational permissions.
Metadata work leaves original evidence and substantive rulings unchanged; substantive edits return to the mufti.
Public previews remove private data, pass independent guards and preserve originals when withdrawn.
Delivery checks original-channel capabilities; uncertain or partial attempts require review without automatic channel switching.
Identity, bulk changes and export need distinct authorization and audit; reading alone grants none of them.

features.title: التنظيم والمراجع متعددة الطبقات
features.summary: Separate reference-tree versions, tags, question types, lesson links and scholarly relations from evidence and machine suggestions.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A development tree retains source/version identity and is never presented as final global scholarly taxonomy.
Metadata and lesson-link changes preserve the original question without implying new substantive evidence.
Renames, moves and merges preserve identifiers and history rather than reusing old IDs for new meanings.
Suggestions require human review; similarity alone establishes no scholarly replacement relation.
Missing optional enrichment does not block safe work; restricted references do not leak through search or relations.

features.title: البحث مع حدود الإتاحة
features.summary: Provide source-linked discovery with separate result types, explicit filters and optional research assistance; restrict access before retrieval.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Public results, suggestions, snippets and counts contain permitted versions only; a private case number grants no access.
Phrase/reference search and spelling normalization preserve original texts and explicit selected constraints.
Result explanations and research assistance cannot generate a ruling or trigger delivery/publication.
A result opens its edition and position; multiple matches are not counted as distinct works.
AI/vector failure preserves available basic search and differs from successful empty results; quality claims require measured fixtures.

features.title: الإحالات إلى نسخة وموضع محددين
features.summary: Keep work, edition, file and location distinct; preview precise human-selected references and recheck source access at use time.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A citation resolves the intended edition, file and location; unknown editions are labelled rather than invented.
Printed/PDF pages remain distinct; unverified offsets never cause guessed page jumps.
A shared citation cannot expose private metadata, files, previews or excerpts; source access is checked on opening.
Fixing a pointer cannot substitute a substantive argument or overwrite the cited version silently.
Assistance proposes supported locations for human insertion; it invents no page, verse, narration or timestamp.

features.title: التوصيل والنشر والنسخ
features.summary: Separate approval, original-channel delivery, publication and derivative editing; track destination results without duplicate sends.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Each action identifies an approved version and original destination; approval, delivery and publication permissions are independent.
Unsupported/multipart replies show limitations without truncation, inferred receipt or automatic channel changes.
Retries target failed parts; uncertainty and new substantive evidence before sending trigger review without duplication.
Public derivatives/media exclude private data; previews and scheduled publication enforce current guards.
Scientific correction requires mufti review; withdrawal preserves originals without claiming to remove external copies.

features.title: وصول السائل الخاص واستعادته
features.summary: Separate private intake/follow-up from public browsing; preserve submitted material and require verified revocable access.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Receipt follows real persistence; interruption preserves the synthetic submitted question.
Case numbers alone open no private case; public links, private access links and identifiers are distinct.
Clarifications, evidence corrections and follow-ups remain in the verified case without leakage or automated scientific inference.
Optional accounts aggregate cases after verification only; recovery/revocation neither deletes cases nor exposes other requesters.
Shared devices, downloads and notifications protect private data; abuse controls require measured policy limits.

features.title: المعرفة العامة وتجربة القراءة
features.summary: Present explicitly published knowledge and precise sources with truthful coverage, Arabic accessibility and separate private journeys. The current metadata catalog is narrower.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Public pages, cards, counts and sharing metadata reveal no internal cases, private names or attachments.
Development classifications show their source and temporary status; missing material is not presented as a populated fatwa/hadith archive.
References open permitted editions/positions; absent files or download rights cannot create misleading action buttons.
Arabic RTL supports keyboard, screen-reader, mobile and zoom checks; WCAG 2.2 AA remains an unverified test target.
Private intake/tracking uses verified separate journeys; final visual design waits for D-070.

features.title: بيانات الحديث قيد الاعتماد
features.summary: Preserve transmitted texts, distinct narrations, chains and attributed scholar statements with optional enrichment; generate no authenticity judgements.

owner_approval.scope: Exact acceptance of the unit clauses is pending; narrower later decisions do not approve the unit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 28 clauses remain pending until exact approval; U09 approval and D-068 do not approve this unit.
Narrations, narrator identities and judgement scope stay distinct; absent grading implies neither weakness nor correctness.
Missing optional chains/commentaries are labelled without invented texts or mandatory placeholders.
Repeated imports preserve identity/provenance without scientific merges or automatic publication.
References, links, exports and assistance obey rights and human review; private cases never become public.

features.title: الدروس والملفات والعمل البشري
features.summary: Keep lesson identity, ordered media and originals separate from technical derivatives and reviewed transcripts; optional enrichment preserves human work.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Ordered lesson files retain original identity; duplicate storage does not merge distinct cases.
Uploads are quarantined, rights govern public variants, and remote links are not treated as owned files.
Processing and review states differ; unclear speech is reported; reprocessing cannot overwrite human-reviewed text.
Timestamps name the exact recording; absent synchronization is not reported as precise.
Secondary failure preserves originals; publishing, download and export obey access and backup integrity.

features.title: علاقات المعرفة ومجموعات الباحث
features.summary: Distinguish official scholarly relations, private research choices and published groups; preserve source versions and permissions in comparison and sharing.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Saving two works together creates no official relation and publishes neither notes nor collections.
Sensitive relation suggestions require human review and cannot silently replace accepted relations.
Traversal filters private nodes, snippets, counts and paths before display; access to one endpoint grants no access to the other.
Comparison preserves attribution and reviewed versions; textual differences are not automatic scientific preferences.
Sharing/export obeys recipient source access; removing a saved item does not delete its source.

features.title: نقل البيانات وعقود التكامل
features.summary: Scope import/export packages and APIs with provenance, preview, conflict review and stable identity; imported approval labels confer no authority.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Export previews fix permitted scope and record omissions, source versions, hashes and rights.
Dry-run changes no live rulings and sends/publishes nothing; file or mapping changes invalidate old previews.
Repeat import preserves IDs without wrong merges, overwriting human work or trusting an approval text field.
Declared round-trip fixtures preserve versions, relations, order and permitted files without restoring secrets.
Public releases, API credentials and notifications require separate rights, documented contracts and revocation checks.

features.title: الأدوار والخصوصية ودورة الحياة
features.summary: Separate people, external identities and accounts; check operation/resource access and recorded lifecycle actions. D-067 is a narrow later hierarchy overlay.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The three internal roles stay explicit; admin hierarchy cannot imply substantive rulings authority or mufti-account activation.
Identity linking/splitting preserves origins and cannot expose names publicly; optional links differ from verified proof.
Privacy covers search, media, exports, audit and recovery; revoked accounts retain attribution but lose access.
Lifecycle previews identify affected derivatives/backups; restoration cannot revive withdrawn content or credentials.
Policy-bypass instructions in sources are data; assistance has registered tasks and cannot grant itself tools or permissions.

features.title: التشغيل والتعافي بأدلة فعلية
features.summary: Report real journey states and failures; preserve resumable work, incident records and consistent restore evidence without invented recovery targets.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Reports separate approval, processing, delivery and publication with defined counts; technical health alone proves no user journey.
Degradation preserves permitted basic work; resumable tasks reconcile uncertain provider results without duplicate outbound actions.
Diagnostics, quality checks and incidents are traceable without leaking private content or secrets.
Isolated recovery matches database, media, versions and permissions; actual RPO/RTO and missing files are measured.
Recovery reapplies revocations and withdrawals before reopening; previously executed external tasks are not replayed.

features.title: مطابقة النطاق والاختبارات والترحيل
features.summary: Trace requirements and independent evidence through preparation, controlled migration, acceptance and handoff; this catalog is not full platform delivery.

owner_approval.scope: Recorded approval of this unit description only; executive details, implementation and release remain unaccepted.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Original review, additions, later decisions and clauses are reconciled individually; disabled/untested features are never reported complete.
Gate contracts and repository boundaries precede dependent operations; this lane changes no legacy system.
Authorized isolated synthetic migration preserves IDs, originals, attribution, ordered files, permissions and follow-up links with outbound actions disabled.
Cutover/rollback preserves subsequent changes and names one external-action owner; matching counts alone is insufficient.
Acceptance records code SHA, fixture identity, environment, commands, failures, NOT_RUN checks and independent review; deployment requires separate gates.

features.title: حدود الإدارة والسلطة العلمية
features.summary: MUFTI and ORGANIZER_ADMIN have equivalent administrative hierarchy; ORGANIZER has configurable lower operational access; only MUFTI creates or approves substantive rulings.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A proposed matrix preserves equivalent MUFTI/ORGANIZER_ADMIN administrative hierarchy without wildcard grants; scholarly creation/approval remains MUFTI-only.
All 70 historical permission rows remain DENY_DEFAULT/NONE_CANDIDATE_BINDING_ONLY; 58 draft transitions create no endpoint and DOMAIN_TRANSACTION creates no principal.

features.title: مساعدة الاستشهاد البشرية لاحقًا
features.summary: Inline scholarly citation suggestions belong to later V1 development and require human review; no AI fatwa drafting or approval.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AI calls remain disabled in this sprint. A future authorized citation suggestion must cite an exact permitted source and require a human to insert it.
A future negative test rejects invented sources and AI writing/approval of a ruling; basic reading/search survives disabled assistance.

features.title: التكامل الخارجي مع ChatGPT مؤجل
features.summary: External ChatGPT integration is V2 and excluded from the current development slice.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Current registry/tooling performs no external ChatGPT calls; any future V2 work needs its own exact authorization, data boundary and acceptance evidence.

features.title: فهرس فقهي مرجعي للكتاب 622
features.summary: A public read-only fiqh TOC for book 622, Kashshaf al-Qina Ministry of Justice edition, is one Hanbali reference index; it is neither published fatwas nor the approved global taxonomy.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: With the exact source ZIP supplied and hash verified, compare all 11,397 IDs/names and parent/order/page edges; expect 32 roots (30 books plus 2 introductions) and max depth 5. This acceptance check is NOT_RUN here.
Desktop/mobile/keyboard browsing and bounded Arabic title search preserve original source IDs/text, ordering, edition and printed pages, and distinguish one Hanbali reference from rulings.
Negative API/search checks reject product mutations and reveal no private case, requester, unapproved answer or active admin capability.

features.title: العلوم الأخرى تنتظر مصادرها
features.summary: Non-fiqh reference data is deferred until its source is supplied; historical future capabilities are retained without claiming populated content or owner deletion.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No hadith or other-science content is invented from book 622; future source availability and rights are evidenced before a new data slice.

features.title: التصميم النهائي بعد الوظائف المقبولة
features.summary: Temporary functional UI precedes final branding and Figma; final design follows completion of owner-accepted functions.

owner_approval.scope: Decision recorded in the 2026-10-13 repository mandate; original decision log unavailable. Scope limited to this decision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Final Figma/branding work remains deferred until the owner accepts the exact functional scope; a visual preview cannot count as functional acceptance.

features.title: عمليات خارج الدفعة الحالية
features.summary: Private intake, user administration, substantive approval, publishing, delivery, production migrations and legacy Telegram edits are outside this development task. This exclusion is not permanent feature removal.

owner_approval.scope: Current engineering scope/plan only; no independent owner product acceptance recorded.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The S6 changes consist only of owned documentation and read-only registry checks; no product operation, account grant, database migration, provider message or legacy-system change occurs.

features.title: خطة دفعات للمراجعة
features.summary: The slices are a suggested ordering of safe development work and blocked future capabilities; scheduling is not approval, activation or deletion.

owner_approval.scope: Current engineering scope/plan only; no independent owner product acceptance recorded.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every feature has a precise evidence anchor, independent owner approval, dependencies, sensitivity, proposed slice and planned acceptance criteria.
Release ordering, deferred work and any requested deletions are presented to the owner for exact decisions; no generic encouragement is substituted for acceptance.
